MANUSCRIPT_TECHNICAL_READY.justification: All scientific claims bounded to M=82 convenience frame; mathematical proofs separated from empirical trials; exact hypergeometric upper bound K<=2 (2.439%) verified; dual Python 3.14 and Rust 1.99 cross-execution confirmed at 480/480 (100.0%) with 0 discrepancies.

EDITORIAL_POLICY_COMPLIANT.justification: Compiled using official Definitions/mdpi.cls template (15 pages); abstract condensed to 181 words single paragraph in plain visible text; all 34 references verified authentic with Guest Editor citation (Nam & Yang 2026 Electronics 15(18), 4334).

REPRODUCIBILITY_VERIFIED.justification: Multi-tier reproduction manual established across Level 1 (statistical recompute < 2 min), Level 2 (cross-interpreter CPU run < 10 min), and Level 3 (generative SLM GPU inference); data availability clearly partitions public safe aggregates from restricted manifests.

PUBLIC_RELEASE_READY.justification: Public release of raw third-party GitHub manifests and proprietary source code remains blocked pending human PI licensing sign-off and post-acceptance release protocol.

SUBMISSION_READY.justification: Automated pipeline halts prior to third-party transmission. Upload to MDPI SuSy submission portal must be manually executed by the Principal Investigator / Corresponding Author.
